description: This file defines the StreamInterface interface, which specifies the methods for handling data streams, such as reading, writing, seeking, and metadata retrieval. It serves as a contract for implementing stream functionalities in the PSR HTTP Message standard.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the stream's contents to a string by reading from the beginning to the end.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream and underlying resources.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the underlying PHP stream resource, leaving the stream in an unusable state.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if known.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the read/write pointer in the stream.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream is at the end.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is seekable.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the stream.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Seeks to the beginning of the stream.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns the remaining contents of the stream.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves stream metadata or specific metadata key.
